description: This file defines a class 'Matrix' providing utility functions for matrix manipulations such as transposing matrices, checking vector types, and indexing into matrices. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's calculation module, specifically related to lookup and reference functions.

classes.name: Matrix
classes.description: A utility class for matrix operations such as transpose, vector checks, and element retrieval in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: isColumnVector
methods.description: Checks if the given array of values is a column vector by comparing the recursive and normal counts.

methods.name: isRowVector
methods.description: Checks if the given array of values is a row vector based on its array dimensions.

methods.name: transpose
methods.description: Transposes a matrix, converting rows to columns and vice versa.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Indexes into a matrix (or range) to retrieve a specific value or subset, supporting both scalar and array inputs.
